In [[geometry]], the '''quarter order-6 square tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of q{4,6}. It is constructed from *3232 [[orbifold notation]], and can be seen as a half symmetry of *443 and *662, and quarter symmetry of *642.
